scope: Pinned upstream HBA replacement: producer EOF, checksum rejection, helper SIGKILL before/after rename, immutable prepared revisions, competing writers and lock-holder death. Not full operation revocation, power-loss or activation recovery.
checks: native local Linux daemon
host headroom checked before bounded probe
owned exact container is isolated and memory bounded
upstream bootstrap roles present
neighbor role is unprivileged without inherited memberships
legacy producer EOF publishes truncated active file
atomic writer rejects producer EOF before expected length
atomic writer rejects same-length wrong content
helper SIGKILL before rename preserves complete old file
helper SIGKILL after rename leaves complete new file
replacement preserves mode uid and gid
new complete HBA parses without errors
explicit reload acknowledges signal
normal complete replacement returns original content
prepared request captures exact container identity
first prepared write succeeds
competing stale prepared write is rejected
successful prepared request cannot replay
same rules receive a different revision header
same rules new revision succeeds
old expected revision does not revive after same rules
busy writer lock refuses without changing target
writer lock releases after stopped helper death
versioned HBA remains valid configuration
disposable database did not OOM
exact disposable container absent from successful inventory
